title: Took the AI work to the company's Innovation Impact Week
summary: I gave two sessions at the company's Innovation Impact Week, on AI-assisted requirements and on the traceability platform; the platform deep dive led to a request for a walkthrough with the CIO.
what_would_have_happened: The platform would stay known mainly to the businesses already using it.
the_call: Use a company-wide stage to reach architects, verification and validation teams and quality professionals.
what_i_did: Built the requirements session around standards, compliant requirements and prompts, and presented the platform in a deep dive.
what_changed: New teams asked for demos and for help judging the platform's fit, and the team was asked to arrange a walkthrough with the CIO.
